task.ques: A polyominoes of order 6 means you have 6 identical squares to combine different shapes (2-sided). How many combinations are there? Looking at all the shapes in the result, how many of them have only 2 rows in total?

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: There are 35 two-sided polyominoes of order 6, and 12 of the displayed shapes occupy exactly two rows.

Evidence: WolframAlpha's “polyomino | order 6” result lists “including orientation (2-sided) | 35.” In its fully expanded Images diagram, the two-row shapes are positions 2–9 and 18–21, counting left to right, top to bottom. The one-row straight shape is excluded.
Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=polyominoes+of+order+6
Screenshot: final.png (viewport, 1280 × 1111 pixels).
